panel.objective: Replace with the exact decision this letter drives. Example: would this policyholder call the office after reading the renewal letter, or set it down and start shopping?
panel.decision_signal: Replace with the observable action. Example: calls or emails the agency about this letter within two weeks of receiving it.
panel.review_due: Set a date to re-read these seats against the book.
panel.calibration_outcome: Replace with the real outcome you will count after the mailing. Example: inbound calls referencing the letter, non-renewals in the mailed cohort, or cross-sell quote requests.
panel.calibration_horizon: Replace with how long after the mailing you will count it. Example: 45 days from the drop date.
